The layer is additive and the historical v1, v2, readiness, and steward-receipt selftests remain passing.

The host observer is excluded by exact reference and by exact Ed25519 public-key bytes, including renamed key aliases.
Distinct key references backed by duplicate public-key bytes are rejected before any signature can count.
Each signature binds the exact readiness digest, trust-policy digest, assurance-record reference, verifier-key reference, identifier, and bounded signing time.

A proposed edit to the original component README was removed after the intake receipt detected byte drift; discovery remains in the additive TEST README.

openSeams.truth: The v2 request does not bind the independent assurance trust-policy digest; software cannot infer requester acceptance.
Distinct valid keys do not prove distinct organizations, absence of collusion, competence, or measurement quality.
Resource budgets remain declarations and signed assurance content; no live executor, enforcement trace, or output bytes were observed.
